ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Ship Vermin
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SHIP_VERMIN_MOD_1 — owner ruling, 2026-09-11, verbatim: "gather all the 'ship infesting' critters together into a single mod 'ShipVermin' that allows the mechanics, creatures, and future cool ideas to emerge. Some are cute, some are hideous, some live inside, some can live outside in vaccuum (the mynock for example)." One home for every ship-infesting critter, so a future species lands here instead of spawning its own mod.
SHIPVERMIN_FREE_TIER_BEASTS_1 — owner ruling (card, typed, 2026-10-07): "Make the free tier have its own beasts that get patched by the Star Wars bestiary when active. Same mechanics same mod otherwise." This mod depends on no franchise content. It ships its own cast: - RM_Skivvik: a vacuum-proof hull leech that drifts to a powered hull, breeds (soft cap 3 / hard cap 12 per map, group tag "ShipVermin") and gnaws lights, conduits and laid floor. - RM_Rattagh: a sociable, toxin-proof pest rodent of wreck voids. - RM_Gorrud: a nocturnal predatory rodent of holds and wrecks. - RM_Fethrik: a fuel mite that sprays chemfuel in a cone (RM_FethrikFuelSpew). When mandrake.rsw.swbestiary is loaded, that mod's own patch (Patches/ShipVermin/RSW_ShipVermin_CanonCast.xml) gives its canon creatures the same mechanics and swaps them into the same four nest slots (RM_ShipVerminCanonSwapExtension). Mechanics are unchanged either way.
The breeding/seek/gnaw machinery is mandrake.rm.biomes' CreatureBehaviors kit; this mod sets it on RM_Skivvik in Defs/ThingDefs_Races/RM_ShipVermin_Cast.xml. RM_Alert_ShipVermin is the population alert (group tag "ShipVermin").
WRECKAGE_VERMIN_SPAWN_1 (2026-09-12), owner ruling verbatim: "Yes vermin should be able to spawn from wreckage." RM_CompProperties_VerminNest / RM_CompVerminNest is a generic "nest under the wreckage" comp: attach it via a comps-list patch to any wreckage ThingDef and it periodically spawns one wild pawn from the settings-enabled nest roster nearby, gated by the same RM_MapComponent_VerminPopulation group-tag pool the breeder respects (default tag "ShipVermin", hard cap 12), so a nest and a breeding population press against ONE shared ceiling. This mod does NOT decide which ThingDef counts as wreckage — a campaign's own patch layer wires the comp onto its own defs (Utinni layer: Patches/WreckVerminNest_ShipChunk.xml in mandrake.rut.patches).
Mod Settings: alert on/off, fuel spew on/off, wreck-nest on/off, a nest rate multiplier, and one checkbox per nest slot (labelled with whichever creature fills the slot).
Art: the four free species render with tinted vanilla placeholder textures (sparrow, rat, boomrat, megascarab). Their own art is owed.
